comparability_policy: Never merge atmospheric air corona, reduced-pressure air corona, CO2 DBD, wind-tunnel flight-flow, and RF-CCP into one unqualified cohort.
Keep maximum values from different electrode configurations as separate records.
Separate absolute thrust, per-span thrust, thrust density, thrust-to-power, thrust-to-weight, and net effective thrust after frame drag.
A source figure export or interpolating pickle is not a raw instrument time-series.
Unknown values are null, not zero; absent source conditions remain explicit.
Power boundary and system-mass boundary are required before cross-study ranking.

thrust_absolute.definition: Direct force measurement or derived force; method must be explicit.

thrust_per_span.definition: Force normalized by active span; not interchangeable with total thrust.

thrust_density.definition: Force divided by declared reference frontal/active area; area definition is mandatory.

thrust_to_power.definition: Thrust divided by declared power boundary; numeric equivalence is only after correct SI conversion.

thrust_to_weight.definition: Thrust/weight with exact mass included; collector-only mass is not aircraft system T/W.

effective_thrust.definition: Net force after declared frame/electrode aerodynamic drag; separate from ionic thrust.

real_ac_power.definition: Cycle-mean real power from simultaneous u(t), i(t) using the declared time integration window.

electrical_terminal_power.definition: Simultaneous measured terminal V·I for DC; not automatically wall-plug power.

system_wall_power.definition: Complete supply input including converter and auxiliary loads where measured.

complete uncertainty values and covariance for the 10 repeated trials

system mass and integrated power boundary

provenance.transcription_scope: article abstract and accessible experimental-method excerpts; no raw instrument data imported

comparability.notes: Keep the exact abstract headline thrust values separate from approximate Figure 9 visual digitizations. The Fig. 9 comparison suggests approximately 3.0 vs 2.4 N/kW at 22 kV for the named conventional/sub-unit-plus configurations, with approximately 0.77 vs 1.34 mA. Those graph-read estimates are not raw data or a benchmark-grade T/P result. Do not infer that the 68.70 mN configuration is the efficiency optimum. Figure 10 gives a within-study 22 kV geometry sweep with reported mean thrust values and 95% confidence-interval error bars; retain those as a separate configuration cohort.

solver_profiles.formulation: monolithic drift-diffusion species equations coupled with Poisson as DAEs; fully implicit adaptive time integration
optional_dependencies: LoKI-B for electron energy distribution and swarm coefficients
important_limits: does not by itself solve the full neutral-gas Navier–Stokes and EHD thrust problem
GPL-3.0 and MATLAB toolchain require an explicit dependency/license decision
source paper journal issue is dated Jan 2027, after this atlas date; repository and dataset are already publicly available
solver_profiles.recommended_role: external discharge-physics engine for matching atmospheric corona/DBD benchmark cases; couple to a separately qualified neutral-flow model and explicit momentum exchange
RF-CCP cohort only unless separate verification/validation establishes suitability for another discharge regime
solver_profiles.important_limit: The 2023 published V&V focuses on 1D/2D RF capacitively coupled plasma at 0.1–1 Torr; a 2019 GEC meeting abstract also reports atmospheric-device comparisons such as the COST plasma jet. This is not automatic validation for atmospheric corona EHD thrusters, flight DBD, or a complete neutral-flow/thrust model.

solver_profiles.current_claim_boundary: not a plasma, corona, ion-transport, Maxwell or EHD fluid solver

capabilities: drift-diffusion charged species coupled with Poisson/electrostatics
DC, ICP, CCP, corona and dielectric barrier discharge interfaces (specific add-ons / interfaces required)
nonisothermal plasma flow and heat transfer coupling
important_limits: The simplified Corona Discharge interface models the transport region and omits the ionisation layer; electron dynamics are not solved in that simplified interface.
Use the full Plasma or Electric Discharge interface when the selected problem requires self-consistent discharge physics; exact interface capability depends on licensed modules and version.
Product feature availability does not qualify a particular EHD thruster geometry, mesh, chemistry, neutral-flow closure or force prediction.
Commercial license, module entitlement and reproducible model-file availability must be accounted for in any benchmark.
solver_profiles.recommended_role: commercial reference baseline for matched corona/DBD plus CFD/EHD cases; record exact COMSOL version, modules, interface, mesh and model files. Do not treat a product feature list as independent validation.

solver_reference_cases.purpose: source-pinned discharge I-V reproduction case; not a thrust/flow validation

linked_experiment.paper: Kiousis, Moronis & Fruh, Electro-Hydrodynamic (EHD) Thrust Analysis in Wire-Cylinder Electrode Arrangement
linked_experiment.relation: The Merlino2D repository README and plotting script state that this case's I-V comparator is the Kiousis et al. experiment. The primary article metadata independently confirms the paper concerns wire-cylinder DC EHD and reports thrust/current and geometry trends; this exact CSV-to-paper data provenance has not yet been reconciled against the paper's full tables/figures.

geometry.dimension: 2D Cartesian cross-section, half-domain represented above the symmetry plane
geometry.note: The .geo file places the emitter centre at x=0 and collector near surface at x=30 mm; with a 50 µm emitter radius, the derived metal-surface clearance is 29.95 mm. The README describes the spacing as 30 mm. Preserve both the source parameter and geometric clearance; do not silently substitute one.

operating_conditions.provenance: DefaultMerlino2Dinput.m defaults; case input does not override PRESSURE or TEMPERATURE.

model.formulation: 2D drift-diffusion species equations coupled to electrostatic Poisson; DAE
model.transport: case-specific analytic mobility expressions and diffusion coefficients
model.photoionization: not configured in this input case
model.electrode_current_boundary: external circuit includes R=0.001 ohm; this is the simulation's series resistance, not a measured thruster power boundary
model.solver_note: The Merlino2D paper states the IDAS MATLAB wrapper is available with MATLAB R2024a; its general solver also supports ode15s, but changing integrators is a separate controlled comparison.

plot_conversion.simulated_integrated_current_to_microamp: multiply by 2e6 because upstream plot script doubles the half-domain model current
plot_conversion.voltage: both model and experimental plotted in kV

derived_descriptive_fit.claim_ceiling: Descriptive fit of the 10 repository CSV rows only; not a physical law, not a solver result, and not an independent replication.

limitations: The CSV is bundled in the Merlino2D repository, not independently traced row-by-row to the primary article's raw measurement files.
No measurement uncertainty, instrument calibration, exact pressure/humidity or raw time-series are present in the CSV.
This benchmark checks discharge I-V response only; it contains no thrust, gas velocity, neutral momentum or energy-efficiency measurement.
The model comparison's factor-of-two current scaling must be preserved and explicitly justified by the half-domain symmetry before reporting error.

qualification_gates.preflight: Pin source commit, license, MATLAB version, Gmsh version, IDAS availability, Te_Air.csv, s_Parent chemistry, exact .geo and case input.
qualification_gates.first_reproduction: Run exact upstream input unchanged, retain raw output and solver statistics, and reproduce the repository's plotted model curve from out.yout.
qualification_gates.data_gate: Verify the 10 experimental CSV points, units and factor-of-two model-current convention; obtain the primary article's full table/figure or author data to reconcile provenance and uncertainty.
qualification_gates.numerical_gate: Mesh refinement of .geo scales and DAE tolerance sweeps; report I-V changes, mesh counts, IDAS steps/failures and runtime.
qualification_gates.transfer_gate: Only after exact reproduction, compare against one changed geometry or pressure as an out-of-cohort test; do not treat it as validated.

solver_reference_cases.claim_boundary: Source-pinned candidate for reproducing a published/repository-linked atmospheric corona discharge I-V curve. No Merlino2D run has been executed by Luminous; no solver accuracy, thrust prediction, EHD flow coupling or SOTA claim is established.
